text_block_list.text:
Phew! I'm beat! I think this old body's
had enough
for today.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: You know what I mean. It was tough.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I've come this far. Surely I can put up a
good
fight... or maybe not.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер is most likely caught up in
thinking
about the fast-approaching
Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You said it! You have to take
responsibility if it
doesn't pay off!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I better start looking into what kind of
fancy meal
you can treat me to when
that happens. I'm
thinking hot pot or
pufferfish.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And with that, Найс Нэйчер's productive
summer
camp comes to an end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
